title: Skin Care for Patna Weather: A Routine for Hot Dusty Summers, Humid Monsoons and Foggy Winters
ex: Hot dry winds, a sticky monsoon and cold foggy winters: a simple, season-by-season skin care routine for people living in Patna.
rt: Skin Care for Patna Weather by Season | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Patna weather: sun and dust care for hot summers, light layers in the humid monsoon and a richer routine for cold, foggy Patna winters.
quick: Patna has a very hot, dusty summer from about April to June, a humid monsoon to September and a cold, foggy winter from December to February. Keep a gentle face wash and broad-spectrum sunscreen all year, go lighter in the hot and wet months, and use a richer night cream and lip balm in winter.
facts: April to June brings very hot days and dry, dusty afternoon winds
The monsoon runs roughly late June to September
December and January bring dense fog and cold-wave spells
Hot baths and room heaters in winter dry out skin
